40008748.author: पदार्थः
40008748.content: महाबाहो longarmed, महाबलपराक्रम strong and powerful, राम O Rama, पुरा in the past, सोमस्य the Moon's, शक्रस्य Indra's, यथा as, सूर्यस्य च the Sun's, वपुः body, यथा like that, मम my,रूपम् form, अचिन्त्यम् inconceivable, त्रिषु लोकेषु in the three worlds, विश्रुतम् renowned, आसीत् it was.

40008748.author: Translation
40008748.content: O longarmed, mighty and powerful Rama in the past I was handsome like the Moon or Indra or the Sun inconceivable to all the three worlds.

40008749.author: पदार्थः
40008749.content: राम Rama, सः that, अहम् I, लोकवित्रासनम् a great terror in the world, महत् great, इदं रूपम् this form, कृत्वा after creating, ततस्ततः eventually, वनगतान् those men in the forests, ऋषीन् seers, त्रासयामि used to terrorise.

40008749.author: Translation
40008749.content: With my appearance, I was a great nuisance to the world and used to terrorise the sages living in the forest.

40008750.author: पदार्थः
40008750.content: ततः then, विविधम् different, वन्यम् forest material, सञ्चिन्वन् while collecting, स्थूलशिराः नाम by name Sthulasira, महर्षिः seer, अनेन by this, रूपेण form, धर्षितः was assaulted, मया by me, कोपितः was enraged.

40008750.author: Translation
40008750.content: With my appearance I invited the wrath of Sthulasira who I assaulted among the many seers, while he was collecting food in the forest.

40008751.author: पदार्थः
40008751.content: प्रेक्ष्य seeing me, घोरशापाभिधायिना  pronounced a dreadful curse, तेन by him, अहम् I, एवम् in that way, उक्तः said, ते you, नृशंसम् mean, विगर्हितम् dispising, एतत् this, रूपमेव form only, अस्तु it may be.

40008751.author: Translation
40008751.content: Seeing me he pronounced a dreadful curse on me saying, 'You will get a cruel, despicable form.'

40008752.author: पदार्थः
40008752.content: क्रुद्धः angry, सः he, अभिशापकृतस्य pronounced on, शापस्य curse's, अन्तः end of it, भवेत् may be, इति thus, मया by me, प्रार्थितः begged, तेन by him, इदम् this, वचः words, भाषितम् spoke.

40008752.author: Translation
40008752.content: When I sought to know how the curse angrily pronounced on me would come to an end, he said:

40008753.author: पदार्थः
40008753.content: रामः Rama, भुजौ two arms, छित्त्वा cutting, त्वाम् you, यदा when, विजने in a desolate, वने in forest, दहेत् cremate, तदा then, स्वमेव your own, विपुलम् शुभम् greatly auspicious, रूपम् form, प्राप्स्यसे you will obtain.

40008753.author: Translation
40008753.content: 'When Rama gets your arms in a desolate forest amputated and your body cremated, you would get back your gloriously auspicious form.'

40008754.author: पदार्थः
40008754.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, दनोः Danu's family, श्रिया by prosperity, विराजितम् shining, पुत्रम् son, त्वम् you, विद्धि know, इन्द्रकोपात् by the wrath of Indra, रणाजिरे in the battlefield, एवम् this, इदं रूपम् this form, प्राप्तम् is obtained.

40008754.author: Translation
40008754.content: O Lakshmana know that I was the prosperous son of demon Danu. By the wrath of Indra in the battlefeild I obtained this form.

40008755.author: पदार्थः
40008755.content: अहम् I, उग्रेण by intense, तपसा by penance, पितामहम् the creator Brahma, आतोषयम् I made him happy, सः he, मे my, दीर्घम् long, आयुः life, प्रादात् graced, ततः then, माम् me, विभ्रमः confusion, अस्पृशत्  overtook me.

40008755.author: Translation
40008755.content: I pleased the creator Brahma with great penance. He blessed me with long life. Then this pride and confusion overtook me.

40008756.author: पदार्थः
40008756.content: मया by me, दीर्घम् long, आयुः life, प्राप्तम् has been attained, शक्रः Indra, मे to me, किं करिष्यति  what can he do, इत्येवम् in that manner, बुद्धिम् in mind, आस्थाय considering, रणे in battle, शक्रम् Indra, अधर्षयम् I attacked .

40008756.author: Translation
40008756.content: Having been blessed with long life and thinking, what can Indra do to me?, I attacked him.

40008757.author: पदार्थः
40008757.content: तस्य his, बाहुप्रयुक्तेन deployed  from his arm, शतपर्वणा by a weapon of hundred nodes, वज्रेण with the thunderbolt, सक्थिनी चैव both my lower limbs, मूर्धा च head also, शरीरे into the body, सम्प्रवेशितम् entered.

40008757.author: Translation
40008757.content: The thunderbolt having a hundred nodes deployed by Indra pierced my thighs and my head.

40008758.author: पदार्थः
40008758.content: सः he, मया by me, याच्यमानः सन् being begged of him, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama, न आनयत् did not take me, तत् that, पितामहवचः word of the creator, सत्यम् true, अस्तु इति should become true, मम to me, अब्रवीत् said.

40008758.author: Translation
40008758.content: Entreated, he did not send me to the abode of Yama ( lord of death) and said, 'Let the words of the creator be true' .

40008759.author: पदार्थः
40008759.content: वज्रेण by the thunderbolt, अभिहतः struck by, भग्नसक्थिशिरोमुखः with thigh bones, head and face broken, अनाहारः starving, सुदीर्घं कालम् for a long time, जीवितुमपि to live, कथम् somehow, शक्तः was possible.

40008759.author: Translation
40008759.content: Hit by the thunderbolt, my thighbones, head and face were broken. Somehow I could manage to live for a long time without food.

40008760.author: पदार्थः
40008760.content: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having been entreated, शक्रः Indra, मे to me, योजनम् one yojana, आयतौ long, बाहू two arms, प्रादात् he gave, मे to me, कुक्षौ in the stomach, तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रम् with sharp teeth, आस्यं च mouth also, अकल्पयत् created.

40008760.author: Translation
40008760.content: Having been entreated, Indra created in me two long arms extending upto a yojana and set my mouth with sharp teeth in the stomach.

40008761.author: पदार्थः
40008761.content: सः अहम् with that I, अस्मिन् in this, वने in the forest, दीर्घाभ्याम् with long, भुजाभ्याम् with arms, अस्मिन् in this, वने in the forest, समन्ततः all over, चरान् moving creatures, सिंहव्दिपमृगव्याघ्रान् lions, tigers, elephants and deer, संकृष्य after pulling, भक्षयामि I eat.

40008761.author: Translation
40008761.content: Stretching the long arms in the forest, I dragged creatures like lions, tigers, elephants and deer moving in the forest and ate them.

40008762.author: पदार्थः
40008762.content: सः that, इन्द्रः तु Indra too, माम् to me, अब्रवीत् said, यदा when, सलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, रामः Rama, समरे in the fight, बाहू छेत्स्यते cuts off the arms, तदा then, स्वर्गम् heaven, गमिष्यसि you will go.

40008762.author: Translation
40008762.content: Indra too had said, 'When Rama along with Lakshmana cuts off your arms in a fight,  you would reach heaven.'

40008763.author: पदार्थः
40008763.content: राजसत्तम best of kings, राम Rama, अस्मिन् वने in this forest, अनेन वपुषा with this body, यद्यत् whatever, पश्यामि I see, सर्वस्य of all, ग्रहणम् catch, साधु proper, रोचये I like.

40008763.author: Translation
40008763.content: O Rama, the best of kings I thought it was only proper in this forest and with this body to catch whatever creature I saw.

40008764.author: पदार्थः
40008764.content: रामः Rama, अवश्यम् certainly, ग्रहणम् into the hold, समुपैष्यति will come, अहम् I, मन्ये  thinking, इमाम् this, बुद्धिम् thought, पुरस्कृत्य depending on, देहन्यासकृतश्रमः I am struggling to preserve my body.

40008764.author: Translation
40008764.content: O Rama, I was struggling to preserve my body all the time thinking that some day you would certainly come into my arms.

40008765.author: पदार्थः
40008765.content: राघव Rama, त्वम् you, सः रामः that Rama, असि you are, ते भद्रम् be blessed, महर्षिणा by the seer, तत्त्वम् truly, एवम् in that way, यथा as, उक्तम् stated, अहम् I, अन्येन by others, हन्तुम् be attacked, शक्यः possible, न not.

40008765.author: Translation
40008765.content: You are that Rama. Be blessed. As stated by the seer I cannot be really killed by any one except you.

40008766.author: पदार्थः
40008766.content: नरर्षभ O best of men, अहम् I, अग्निना by fire, संस्कृतः purified man, युवाभ्याम् by you both, मतिसाचिव्यम् help you with my wisdom, करिष्यामि I will do, मित्रं चैव as a friend also, उपदेक्ष्यामि I will advise you.

40008766.author: Translation
40008766.content: O best among men I will help you with my wisdom and give you friendly advice when I am purified by you both through cremation on the funeral pyre.

40008767.author: पदार्थः
40008767.content: तेन by him, दनुना by Danu, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having been told, धर्मात्मा righteous, राघवः Rama, लक्ष्मणस्य to Lakshmana, उपशृण्वतः listening, इदम् these, वचनम् words, जगाद spoke.

40008767.author: Translation
40008767.content: Rigteous Rama spoke the following words in response to the story of Danu within Lakshmana's earshot:

40008768.author: पदार्थः
40008768.content: जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, सह भ्रात्रा along with my brother, निष्क्रान्तस्य when I had gone out, मम my, भार्या wife, यशस्स्विनी famed lady, सीता Sita, रावणेन by Ravana, यथासुखम्  happily, हृता carried off.

40008768.author: Translation
40008768.content: My illlustrious wife Sita was carried away by Ravana comfortably when I was away from Janasthana along with my brother.

40008769.author: पदार्थः
40008769.content: तस्य his, नाममात्रम् only the name, जानामि I know, रूपम् form, न do not know, तस्य his, निवासं वा residence not known, प्रभावं वा or his power, वयम् we, न विद्महे we do not know.

40008769.author: Translation
40008769.content: I only know his name. We do not know how he looks, where he lives and what influence he has.

40008770.author: पदार्थः
40008770.content: शोकार्तानाम् striken by sorrow, अनाथानाम् of orphans, एवम् that way, विपरिधावताम् of those running all over, उपकारे help, वर्ततां च do to others, कारुण्यम् kindness, कर्तुम् do show, सदृशम् worthy of your compasssion.

40008770.author: Translation
40008770.content: Creatures like you may help those who, like orphans, run here and there, stricken with sorrow.

40008771.author: पदार्थः
40008771.content: वीर hero, काले in the proper season, कुञ्जरैः by elephants, भग्नानि broken, शुष्काणि dried, काष्ठानि logs of wood, आदाय after getting, कल्पिते in a place set, महति in a large one, श्वभ्रे in a pit, त्वाम् you, धक्ष्यामः we will cremate you.

40008771.author: Translation
40008771.content: O hero we will cremate you in a huge pit to be prepared for this occasion, collecting dry logs of wood broken by elephants.

40008772.author: पदार्थः
40008772.content: सः he, त्वम् you, तत्त्वतः truly, जानासि यदि if you know, सीताम् about Sita, येन वा by whom, यत्र वा of wherever, हृता carried, समाचक्ष्व tell me, अत्यर्थम् very much, कल्याणम् wellbeing, कुरु you may do.

40008772.author: Translation
40008772.content: If you really know where SIta has been kidnapped and by whom, tell me. You will be doing a great service.

40008773.author: पदार्थः
40008773.content: रामेण by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्तः  having been asked, वक्तुम् telling, कुशलः one who can speak well, दनुः Danu, वक्तारम् addressing one who can speak, राघवम् to Rama, अनुत्तमम् best, वाक्यम् word, प्रोवाच spoke.

40008773.author: Translation
40008773.content: Danu who was proficient in speech spoke with chosen words to Rama who was a great speaker himself:

40008774.author: पदार्थः
40008774.content: मे to me, दिव्यम् divine, ज्ञानम् wisdom, नास्ति I do not have, मैथिलीम् Maithili, नाभिजानामि I do not know, दग्धः burnt one, स्वं रूम् my original form, आस्थितः getting, ताम् her, यः whoever, ज्ञास्यति know of her, तम् him, वक्ष्ये I will reveal.

40008774.author: Translation
40008774.content: I do not have divine wisdom (now). Nor do I know Sita. When you cremate me, I shall assume my original form and will tell you the name of the person who knows it.

40008775.author: पदार्थः
40008775.content: प्रभो O lord, येन by whom, तव your, सीता Sita, हृता is taken away, तम् him, महावीर्यम् very powerful, राक्षसम् rakshasa, विज्ञातुम् to know, अदग्धस्य without being burnt, मे to me, शक्तिः ability, नास्ति is not there.

40008775.author: Translation
40008775.content: O lord before I am cremated, I do not have the ability to know  about that powerful demon by whom Sita has been abducted.

40008776.author: पदार्थः
40008776.content: राघव Rama, शापदोषेण due to the curse, मम my, विज्ञानम् wisdom, भ्रष्टं हि is indeed lost, मया by me, स्वकृतेन by my own deed, लोकविगर्हितम् a form despised by the world, रूपम् this form, प्राप्तम् is attained.

40008776.author: Translation
40008776.content: O Rama due to the curse I have lost my wisdom. By my own deed, I have attained this form despicable to the world.

40008777.author: पदार्थः
40008777.content: राम Rama, किं तु but, सविता Sun, श्रान्तवाहनः with his vehicle (horses) tired, अस्तम् (याति) setting, यावत् before, तावत् by then, माम् me, अवटे in a pit, क्षिप्त्वा dropping, यथाविधि in accordance with tradition, दह you may cremate.

40008777.author: Translation
40008777.content: Before the Sun  disappears with his tired horses drop me into a pit and cremate me in accordance with tradition, O Rama

40008778.author: पदार्थः
40008778.content: वीर O hero, रघुनन्धन O delight of the Raghus, अहम् I, त्वया by you, न्यायेन as per custom, अवटे in a pit, दग्धः cremated, यः whoever, तं राक्षसम् to that demon, ज्ञास्यति knows, तम् about him, वक्ष्यामि I will let you know.

40008778.author: Translation
40008778.content: O heroic Rama, delight of the Raghus, if you drop me in a pit and cremate me as per custom, I will tell you about him who knows the demon.

40008779.author: पदार्थः
40008779.content: राघव Rama, न्याय्यवृत्तेन rightfully conducting, तेन with him, सख्यं च friendship, कर्तव्यम् you should establish, लघुविक्रमः a warrior of swift action, प्रीतः a pleased one, ते to you, साहाय्यम् help, कल्पयिष्यति he will do.

40008779.author: Translation
40008779.content: O Rama you should establish friendship with him in a just manner. That hero of swift action will help you when he is pleased.

40008780.author: पदार्थः
40008780.content: राघव Rama, त्रिषु in the three, लोकेषु worlds, तस्य for him, अविज्ञातम् unknown to him, नास्ति is not there, हि do, असौ he, पुरा in the past, कारणान्तरे for a different cause, सर्वान् all, लोकान् worlds, परिसृतः has roamed about.

40008780.author: Translation
40008780.content: O Rama, there is nothing that he does not know in the three worlds. In the past for a different reason he roamed all the (three) worlds. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकसप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventyfirst sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
